Hi Danielle —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your production inference. I'd like to set up a kickoff call to walk through the CAIQ + SOC 2 intake so we can confirm the evidence workbook and slot upload windows. Proposed agenda (30–45 min):

- Introductions + scope (5 min)
- CAIQ gaplist review (10 min)
- Log/sample access & retention details (10 min)
- Attachment transfer method & timeline (5 min)
- Actions and owners

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Feb 5, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Feb 5, 14:00–14:45
- Fri Feb 6, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, please suggest 1–2 options. For prep, can you share the preferred contact for procurement and the security contact who will own the CAIQ answers?

I'm attaching a short prep checklist and our standard CAIQ gaplist template (blank) — we'll send a partially filled example prior to the call. Ben (copied) will cover the network/log questions.

Thanks,

Thanks Danielle — confirmed for Thu Feb 5, 14:00 PT. Calendar invite sent.

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- Retention: Redwood retains inference request logs for 90 days by default. We can provide a filtered export (CSV) and offer a sampled raw log package for the timeframe you request; if you need longer retention we can discuss a retention SLA for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- SSO/SCIM: Yes — SSO with SAML and SCIM provisioning is supported. We'll flag the CAIQ questions related to identity and include our Okta mapping notes.
- Upload method: Preferred is a shared Google Drive folder with restricted access (we can also support SFTP). I put a secure Drive link in the post-call notes.

Attached: a partially filled CAIQ-gaplist tailored to AtlasWave (AtlasWave-CAIQ-gaplist.xlsx) and a network architecture diagram stub (network-arch-diagram.png). Ben will lead the network/log section on the call.

Agenda for Thu (14:00 PT):
- 14:00 Intro + scope — Naomi
- 14:05 CAIQ gaplist walkthrough — Naomi/Marissa
- 14:20 Network & logs (retention/export) — Ben
- 14:30 Upload method & artifact timelines — Naomi
- 14:35 Actions & owners

See you on the call.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AtlasWave-CAIQ-gaplist.xlsx (stub), network-arch-diagram.png (stub)

Subject: AtlasWave intake — notes, artifacts, and next steps (post-call)

Hi all —

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier today. Notes + action items below (summary first, full notes after).

Summary / decisions:
- Redwood will deliver a filled CAIQ export for 2026-01 to 2026-02 (questions with references) by Wed Feb 11. (Owner: Naomi)
- AtlasWave requested a raw sample of request logs for a 72-hour window (anonymized). Redwood to provide zipped CSV via Drive link by Tue Feb 10. (Owner: Ben)
- SSO/SCIM mapping: Redwood to share Okta mapping doc and SCIM attribute list. (Owner: Marissa)
- Procurement: AtlasWave to send standard PO process + preferred contract contact; Redwood to attach vendor quote if required. (Owner: Naomi / procurement@redwood.com)

Attendees: Naomi Feldman (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood), Danielle Harper (AtlasWave), Michael Lin (AtlasWave security), Raj Patel (AtlasWave procurement)

Detailed notes:
- CAIQ: walked through high-impact control areas. Naomi flagged 5 items with open evidence needs (see attached gaplist).
- Logs: Ben explained that logs include request metadata, model variant, timestamps, and token usage. Default retention 90 days; we can produce filtered exports and sampled raw sets with PII anonymized.
- Network: Ben confirmed egress/IP ranges and provided the diagram (attached).
- Uploads: agreed to use the secure Drive folder linked below. Drive will be shared with atlaswave-security@atlaswave.com and Raj Patel.

Action items (owner / due):
- Naomi: Completed CAIQ export + narrative references (due 2026-02-11)
- Ben: Provide 72-hour anonymized request log sample via Drive (due 2026-02-10)
- Marissa: Share Okta SCIM attribute mapping and sample SCIM provisioning manifest (due 2026-02-09)
- Raj (AtlasWave): Share PO template and contract contact (due 2026-02-12)

Attachments uploaded to Drive: AtlasWave-CAIQ-gaplist.xlsx, network-arch-diagram.png, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AtlasWaveOnboarding
